scoring_justification: Headline barrier heights and Curie temperatures are compared to paper gold; internal consistency between barrier heights and quartic coefficients is also verified to discourage trivial fabrication.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold barrier heights and Curie temperatures from paper Tables 1 and 2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables 1 and 2 (Audzijonis et al., Ferroelectrics 392, 45-54, 2009)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed directly from the published tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported data, used as a reference for comparison; they are the authoritative values for the reproduction task.

outputs.description: Barrier heights ΔV of the B1u soft mode double-well potential for varying temperature, pressure, and Bi composition. The checker compares these to the paper's reported values with a tolerance.
Fitted quartic coefficients for each condition. Checked for consistency (e.g., a≈0, d≈0 in symmetric regimes) with low weight.
Curie temperatures T_C (in K) for each composition and pressure; -1 indicates no transition. The checker compares to paper values within ±10 K.

output_contract.notes: All scored quantities are compared to the paper's hidden gold values with appropriate tolerances (barrier heights ±0.001 a.u., Tc ±10 K).

steps.description: Compare agent barrier heights to paper gold values with absolute tolerance 0.001 a.u.
Check internal consistency: for gold conditions (symmetric double-well) the barrier from coefficients matches the reported barrier height, and a, d are near zero.
Compare agent Curie temperatures to paper gold (±10 K) and check no-transition sentinel for x>0.7.
